decision: 2026-11-17 user-approved design: anneal the differentiable SFT term 0.5 -> 0 and grow the sampled-reward mixture 0.3/0.2 -> 0.4/0.6 over 212 updates

status.note: design, config and an installed source candidate; no package, fixed-image CPU acceptance, NPU run or efficacy claim exists yet

reward_propagation: sampled scalar rewards -> GRPO group centering, population std floor -> probability-ratio clipped surrogate; rewards are never written as differentiable losses

schedule.name: annealed_convex_linear_v1
schedule.rule: linear interpolation at update/total; endpoints exact; the three weights sum to one at every update

supervised.internal_split: NLL/InfoNCE split read from constants.sft_split; frozen at NLL 0.3 / InfoNCE 0.7 (InfoNCE primary; 2026-11-17 user)

ranking.reduction: per group one shared trajectory; the tier is read from its first three positions
ranking.label_rule: any candidate in the complete gold set counts as a hit

probability.statistic: 1 - mean_squared_error(p, target) over the shared k trajectory candidates
probability.trajectory: same shared k-candidate trajectory as ranking and contrast

contrast.reward: fraction of drawn gold/non-gold pairs with p_gold - p_negative >= margin

trajectory.draw: one Plackett-Luce without-replacement draw of k ordered candidates per group
trajectory.log_prob: exact FP64 sum_j log(w_cj / sum_{i not drawn yet} w_i); shape [group_size]; detached

surrogate.advantages: existing GRPO group centering and population-std floor 0.25 on the composite score
surrogate.log_prob_use: the candidate multiplies detached advantages by the shared trajectory log_prob inside the ratio-clipped surrogate

composite: R = w_contrast * (contrast_fraction * margin_reward + (1 - contrast_fraction) * brier_reward) + w_ranking * rank_reward; the supervised weight multiplies only the differentiable SFT term and is not part of R
removal_reason: v9 auxiliary supervised ranking and binary NLL duplicated the sampled ranking/probability signals; the approved curriculum keeps only SFT as differentiable supervision

evaluation.curve_reporting: complete 11-point curve and degradation; no single-step or last-step substitution
evaluation.test_and_transfer: frozen selected policy; no target tuning

relationship_to_v9.v9: constant mixed dual-credit GRPO with binary NLL 0.3 and supervised ranking 0.1; running and frozen, not modified in place
relationship_to_v9.v0_0_4: removes both auxiliary supervised terms; anneals SFT 0.5 -> 0; grows contrast/ranking 0.3/0.2 -> 0.4/0.6
relationship_to_v9.shared: same full clean SLURP source population, DP6 topology, global batch 384, microbatch 8, seed 317, two epochs and 212 updates
relationship_to_v9.new_identity_required: new versioned package and candidate module; never edits the running v9 package or its pins

engineering.note: the source candidate exists, but fixed-image CPU acceptance, runtime parity, NPU update and dispatch gates do not exist yet

open_issues: SFT internal NLL/InfoNCE split frozen at 0.3/0.7 (InfoNCE primary); an ablation can be a separate candidate
the source candidate is implemented but has no fixed-image CPU acceptance, real-audio rollout parity, global reduction or NPU update evidence
trajectory k=8 must not exceed the menu size; helper wrappers keep legacy subset/negatives names as the trajectory length and reject values outside the menu
margin returns 0 with margin_reason for trajectories without gold or without non-gold; diagnostics must count these branches instead of dropping them
log_prob is FP64 and detached; the candidate must reuse the same trajectory draw for the ratio and must not resample
v9 remains the running frozen package; this config cannot be dispatched or merged into it
